_note: Tagged narration for the contrast tutorial, 15 second cut, read on eleven_v3. The words are the ones in src/tutorial/reels/contrast.ts, unchanged; only the inline audio tags are added. scripts/voice.ts strips the tags and refuses to run if what is left is not exactly the narration in src, so the words cannot drift. Tags only ever go to the voice model: captions and the SRT read the untagged narration from src. Direction: warm and confident, a little playful, like a friend who already knows the answer. The one short pause tag that sat before the verdict was removed on 2026-09-24 on Alex's call: it rendered as more than a second of dead air. Every other tag stays.

beats.why: A flat claim. Confident, not announced.

beats.narration: [amused] This amber on cream looks fine.
beats.why: The setup. She already knows it does not pass, so the line gets a light smile rather than a straight face.

beats.narration: [matter-of-fact] It measures two point nine to one. That fails.
beats.why: The number is the verdict, so it is said plainly. No pause tag: the sentence break alone separates "That fails."

beats.narration: [warm] Same palette, rust instead. Six point seven. [pleased] Passes.
beats.why: The fix is the good news. Warm through the line, a small lift of satisfaction on the last word.

beats.narration: [warm] Measure every color you set text in.
beats.why: The takeaway, said like advice to a friend.
